description: This file defines the PayrollPeriod class, includes validation methods for payroll periods, and utility functions for retrieving and calculating payroll periods and related data within an ERP system.

classes.name: PayrollPeriod
classes.description: A Document subclass representing a payroll period with validation logic for date consistency and overlap checks.

methods.name: validate(self)
methods.description: Validates the payroll period by checking date validity and overlaps with existing periods.

methods.name: validate_dates(self)
methods.description: Ensures the start date precedes the end date for the payroll period.

methods.name: validate_overlap(self)
methods.description: Checks for overlapping payroll periods within the same company to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: get_payroll_period_days(start_date, end_date, employee, company=None)
methods.description: Returns the payroll period's name and calculated working days for an employee within a date range, considering holidays if configured.

methods.name: get_payroll_period(from_date, to_date, company)
methods.description: Fetches the payroll period encompassing the given date range for a specific company.

methods.name: get_period_factor(employee, start_date, end_date, payroll_frequency, payroll_period, depends_on_payment_days=0)
methods.description: Calculates the proportion of a payroll period applicable to an employee based on joining and relieving dates, payroll frequency, and other parameters.

ctags.name: get_period_factor
ctags.pattern: /^def get_period_factor(employee, start_date, end_date, payroll_frequency, payroll_period, depends/
